verdict.rationale: Linear's changelog says coding sessions, where Linear Agent writes code, support signed commits once the user adds an SSH or GPG key in Settings. That directly covers signing AI-authored commits with the engineer's own key. The story's 'require' element (enforcing or mandating signing so unsigned AI commits cannot land) is not documented; the evidence only says signing can be enabled, and the source is a single changelog line. Missing for 10: documented enforcement or mandatory-signing policy, details on how signing works in cloud sessions, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an engineer, I can require AI-authored commits to be cryptographically signed with my SSH or GPG key

citations.quote: Coding sessions now support signed commits. Add your SSH or GPG key in Settings to enable signing.
Coding sessions run in the cloud, so you can prototype ideas and make changes without setting up a local development environment.
